description.summary: The caster can emulate a bluish-yellow, sleepy breeze from a treant that surrounds himself and all those creatures within 30-ft
description.value: The caster can emulate a bluish-yellow, sleepy breeze from a treant that surrounds himself and all those creatures within 30-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect must make a Will save or be inflicted with Sleep status effect for 1d6 rounds. Learned From treant
